name: List data modeling jobs which are "runs" for our saved queries.
description: List data modeling jobs which are "runs" for our saved queries. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/data_modeling_jobs/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/data_modeling_jobs/
List data modeling jobs which are "runs" for our saved queries.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: limit (query) — Number of results to return per page.; offset (query) — The initial index from which to return the results.; saved_query_id (query); status (query) — * `Cancelled` - Cancelled * `Completed` - Completed * `Failed` - Failed * `Running` - Running * `Skipped` - Skipped
